posts.raw_content:
Not my TDS of course, but from a childhood friend of mine.  We were friends all through high school through today (we're early 40's now).  I stuck by him when he had a schizophrenic break around 20 years old, was the only friend that was with him, came to see him every day until he was better.  I gave his future wife advice that turned her life around and took her from minimum wage to making good money.  I was the best man in his wedding.  I floated them the money for a down payment on a house when their trailer was at end of life.  Hell, he named is son after me (first/middle name).  

He was always a lefty, his family was big in local trade unions and he was a union guy.  We generally agreed to disagree about politics and kept shit polite, maybe some gentle ribbing here and there.  The problem started with his super libtard wife, who is like lefty to the extreme.  We also generally kept shit cordial, didn't really talk politics.  As the years went on, she got more and more libtarded, and the TDS grew.  Anyway I got divorced last winter and ended up getting on Facebook again around christmas last year.  I immediately noticed he'd graduated to daily TDS posts, shit like republican pedophile alerts, ICE shit, etc.  After like a month or two of seeing it daily I finally commented on one of them that he should maybe tone it down as he was coming across as a wingnut.  He immediately unfriended me on FB, and I noticed and texted him and we haven't really spoke much since.

Anyway, due to libtard mental disease shared from mom, his son decided a while back that he was trans, and they fully embraced it and normalized it.  They moved states last year to MN because our state was 'too transphobic'.  Last week his tranny son, who is deadnamed after me, got ahold of their pistol and shot himself in the face.  Wasn't successful, just apparently blew his jaw off or something.  Anyway, he was talking about it in 'the boys' chat with all of our friend group, and one of the friends mentioned a bible passage and said he'd pray for his family and he freaked out about it.  So I called him last night to try and provide some support in his tough time, see how he was doing, etc.  He didn't answer, texts me today asking what was up and I texted back saying my intentions.  He asked if I was still a Trump supporting white nationalist.  I said I still support Trump, am still white, and want my nation to succeed.  He cut me off and said to start a new group chat with the rest of the boys and exclude him because he was done with all of us.

Feels bad man.  The TDS was novel and something I could make friendly jabs at when it was just his wife.  But it's spread to the whole family, and my good friend...and now he's dead to me.

Sorry for the long post, just had to get it out somewhere, and it's not really facebook material.  Figured you folk here would understand better than most.
